# Maximum Product of Two Digits

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Platform | LeetCode |

| Submitted | 2026-07-26T09:06:19.000Z |


## Solution

```python
class Solution:
    def maxProduct(self, n: int) -> int:
        digits = []
        while n > 0:
            digits.append(n % 10)
            n //= 10
        digits.sort(reverse=True)
        return digits[0] * digits[1]
```
